gap: Tie-breaking for the depth median: Section 3.1 says coordinate-wise median of the deepest points, while Remark 5 says center of gravity/arithmetic mean.
options: center of gravity (arithmetic mean) of deepest points
chosen: center of gravity (arithmetic mean) of deepest points
rationale: The toy median is unique, so no effect there; Remark 5 is the more specific computational rule and is stated as consistent with Rousseeuw et al.
quote: when the set of deepest points contains more than one observation, we define the depth median as the center of gravity of this subset.

gap: Halfspace depth algorithm: exact computation vs finite-direction approximation and the number of directions.
options: another O(n log n) halfspace depth implementation
chosen: aplpack finite-direction approximation using aplpack defaults
rationale: The paper explicitly says the implementation follows aplpack’s direction iteration; exact depth is not required for the toy example but matters for simulations.
quote: we adopt the same approximation method used in the aplpack package in R, which iterates over a fixed set of directions

gap: Bag construction when no depth contour contains exactly 50% of points.

rationale: The paper does not define the maximum over an empty set; this choice preserves the statistical fence.
